The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a workbench introduced with the [[Better Save Soul|Better Save Soul DLC]], that may be built in the [[Souls room]] after you unlock the [[Spiritualism (Tech Tree)|Updated equipment]] technology. The {{PAGENAME}} allows you to store up to 4 souls for later usage, unlike the other 2 previous tiers, {{PAGENAME}} will no longer decay the souls.

To use one of these containers first, you have to build a frame first [[{{PAGENAME}} (Base)]], then fill it up by finishing the build with extra materials [{{PAGENAME}} (Finish)]. There are only 3 spots in the [[Souls room]] where this container can be built.

''Note: When a soul stays in the container for too long, it will eventually die and leave a [[Sin Shard]] behind. No drop in soul condition was observed in soul container III after 2 days , while  in other containers souls decayed. Either rate of decay slow or absent.''
